title: Fixed calculus ordinary tensor
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite field extension E of Q_l. The ordinary tensor integralRingedOrdinaryTensor l E W is the calculus integralClosed.tensor on every scheme W. Its representative is the restriction of calculus.integralTensorModel.comparison to flat-term K-flat representatives, using flat_good to obtain the independent K-flat property. This is actual data, with no completion or geometric finiteness assumption.

source.place: Coefficient-comparison sentence; expanded strict-system realization argument, as recorded in lem-sf-integral-canonical-ambient-models.

proof.text: Take the tensor field of the existing calculus integralClosed structure. A flat-term K-flat complex is independent K-flat by flat_good. The inclusion from flat representatives into the independent K-flat representative category therefore pulls the calculus representative isomorphism back to the required product of flat representative categories. These two fields define the ordinary tensor model directly; no object is selected from a mere existence theorem.
